title: Team-size enforcement, published rules and event readiness values require owner sign-off

original_titles.title: Production schedule and level windows are not configured (synthetic dev windows only)
Per-level score weights, tie-break and penalty policy remain provisional
Level 3 side-quest content and Level 4 rubric are wired but empty (owner input pending)
Option B challenge is a development fixture; production A/B packages pending equivalence certification
CTF quest variety under-delivered: no planted token in Git history; only 2 flags vs 100-pt cap
A/B variant equivalence unvalidated and self-selected per team

problem: Seed data explicitly uses synthetic level windows and development challenge fixtures. Production schedule, final per-level score weights/tie-break/penalty rules, level 3 side quest, level 4 rubric and A/B challenge parity remain organizer/owner inputs. Published team size of 4-5 is not clearly enforced by current roster mutations.
impact: The event can be technically functional but still unfair or not ready because schedule/content/scoring are provisional. A/B challenge differences or team-size mismatch affect comparative fairness.

evidence_paths: backend/seed.py: synthetic schedule and dev fixture content
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Approve exact event schedule and timezone, each level start/end/grace window and the run-of-show; configure the production event rather than relying on seed times.
Approve score weights, tie-breaks, penalty caps, partial credit and dispute correction policy. Store a frozen versioned config and test its hash.
Provide final A/B challenge repositories and ground truth; have two independent reviewers compare bug count, severity, locations, hidden tests and difficulty.
Complete Level 3 side-quest content and Level 4 rubric/reviewer allocation. Remove development fixtures from production seed.
Enforce min/max team size and roster lock timing in the backend, or publish an explicit exception. Add readiness checklist items that block READY until owner inputs are supplied.

acceptance_criteria: All production schedule and scoring fields are approved and frozen.
A/B challenge parity is independently certified.
Team size enforcement matches published rules.
No development fixture or synthetic window is used for a live event.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
